question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Let the cat out of the bag

options.text: To buy a cat and a bag
To not allow a cat into the bag
To release a cat out of a bag

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **To reveal a secret**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Let the cat out of the bag"** means to reveal a secret or disclose information that was supposed to be kept confidential. (राज़ खोल देना)

 
 
• **Example:** She let the cat out of the bag when she accidentally mentioned the surprise party.
 
 

 
• **"Reveal a secret"** means to expose or disclose information that was hidden or private. (गुप्त जानकारी प्रकट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He revealed the secret about the new project to his colleagues before the official announcement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**
